Name: Well With Vines UNDER REDEVELOPMENT
Author: nyayssu
Description:
[b][u]IF YOU DON'T KNOW HOW TO REPLACE XNB'S, PLEASE FOLLOW THESE STEPS!!!

[/u]NOTE: PLEASE MAKE SURE TO BACKUP YOUR FILES AND SAVES BEFORE DOING THIS! IF YOU DID NOT BACKUP FILES, CHANCES ARE THAT YOUR SAVES WILL BE CORRUPTED AND YOU WON'T LIKE THAT :) [/b]

Step 1: go to your "Stardew Valley Folder"
(If it is downloaded on your steam go to C:\Program Files (x86)\steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley)
(If it is downloaded on GOG then go to C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley)

Step 2: Go to [b]"CONTENT" [/b]and find [b]"BUILDINGS". [/b]From there you can see the well.xnb and replace it with the one you have downloaded.

Step 3: Play the game and enjoy!
